items.title: Claude AI Solves 25-Year NSA Cryptography Mystery in Just 30 Minutes
items.description: Anthropic says an internal Claude research model has traced the origins of five NSA-supplied elliptic curve seeds in under 30 minutes, answering a cryptography question that remained open for roughly 25 years.
